network.unreachable: The engine is not responding. It may still be starting.

sidecar.spawn_failed: The engine could not be started. The installation may be incomplete.
sidecar.startup_timeout: The engine did not finish starting in time.
sidecar.not_ready: The engine is still starting. Try again in a moment.

backend.unavailable: The selected engine cannot run on this machine.
backend.unsupported_capability: The selected engine does not support this option.
backend.none_available: No engine is available. Configure a remote API in Settings.

cuda.torch_missing: PyTorch is not installed, so the NVIDIA engine cannot run.
cuda.driver_missing: No CUDA driver was found. Install the NVIDIA driver and restart.
cuda.no_device: The CUDA driver reported no usable GPU.

mps.not_macos: The Apple engine only runs on macOS.
mps.torch_missing: PyTorch is not installed, so the Apple engine cannot run.
mps.torch_without_mps: This build of PyTorch was compiled without Metal support.
mps.device_unavailable: The Metal device is not available on this machine.

remote.api_key_missing: This provider has no API key stored. Edit it in Settings and paste one in.
remote.bad_key: The provider rejected the API key.
remote.endpoint_missing: Add an AI provider in Settings before using the remote engine.
remote.forbidden: The account is not permitted to use this model. It may need billing enabled.
remote.insecure_url: Plain http is accepted only for an endpoint on this machine. An API key sent over it would be readable on the way.
remote.invalid_base_url: That is not a usable base URL. It has to start with https:// and carry no query string.
remote.invalid_header: One of the headers is not usable. Names and values have to be plain text on a single line.
remote.limit_reached: No more providers can be stored. Remove one before adding another.
remote.model_missing: Name the model this provider should generate with.
remote.name_missing: Give the provider a display name.
remote.no_active_provider: Providers are configured, but none is selected. Choose one in Settings.
remote.not_found: The provider has no such model at that endpoint.
remote.provider_unknown: That provider is not configured any more.
remote.rate_limited: The provider is throttling this key. Wait, or check the plan's quota.
remote.reachable: The endpoint answered and accepted the key.
remote.refused: Something is at that address and refused the connection. Check the port.
remote.request_failed: The remote API rejected the request or could not be reached.
remote.secret_read_failed: The API key could not be read. The credential store may be locked.
remote.secret_write_failed: The API key could not be stored. The credential store refused it.
remote.server_error: The provider failed on its own side. Try again shortly.
remote.store_write_failed: The provider list could not be saved. Check the free space and the permissions on this disk.
remote.timeout: The endpoint accepted the connection and then did not answer.
remote.unexpected_shape: Something answered, but not with an OpenAI compatible model list. Check that the base URL points at the API and not at a web page.
remote.unknown_preset: That provider is not one this version knows. Use a custom endpoint instead.
remote.unreachable: That host could not be reached. Check the base URL and your connection.
remote.rejected: The provider refused the request. Check the API key and the model name.

backend.adapter_unsupported: The GPU runtime is missing a package that style adapters need. Install the missing packages in Settings, then restart.
backend.adapter_mismatch: That style adapter was made for a different base model. Pick one that matches the model you selected.

models.download_failed: The model could not be downloaded.
models.downloads_disabled: Downloads are turned off, and this model is not on this machine.
models.unknown: That model is not in the registry.
models.download_rejected: The model host refused the download. The file may have moved.
models.download_unreachable: The model host could not be reached. Check your connection. What had already arrived was kept, so the download can be resumed.
models.download_incomplete: The download ended before the whole file arrived. What had already arrived was kept, so the download can be resumed.
models.download_write_failed: The download could not be saved. Check the free space on this disk.
models.download_range_refused: The file on the model host is no longer the one this download started. What had arrived was removed; download it again to start from the beginning.

runtime.install_failed: The GPU runtime could not be installed.
runtime.unsupported_platform: This version has no PyTorch build pinned for this system and Python version, so it cannot install one here.
runtime.unknown_variant: That is not a build this system can install.
runtime.already_installing: The GPU runtime is already being installed.
runtime.already_installed: The GPU runtime is already installed. Remove it before installing another build.
runtime.not_installed: There is no GPU runtime installed to remove.
runtime.busy_installing: An install is running. Stop it before removing the GPU runtime.
runtime.downloads_disabled: Downloads are turned off, so the GPU runtime cannot be fetched.
runtime.insufficient_space: There is not enough room on that drive for the GPU runtime. Free some space, or move the download folder to another drive in Storage location.
runtime.download_rejected: The PyTorch index refused the download. The build may have been withdrawn.
runtime.download_unreachable: The PyTorch index could not be reached. Check your connection.
runtime.download_incomplete: The download ended before the whole file arrived, so it was discarded.
runtime.checksum_mismatch: A downloaded file was not the one expected, so nothing was installed. Try again; if it keeps happening, something on the way is altering the download.
runtime.unsafe_archive: A downloaded package tried to write outside its own folder and was refused.
runtime.extract_failed: A downloaded package could not be unpacked.
runtime.write_failed: The GPU runtime could not be written. Check the free space on that drive.
runtime.remove_failed: The GPU runtime could not be deleted. A file in it may still be open.
runtime.import_failed: The GPU runtime is installed but will not load. Remove it and install it again.
runtime.nothing_to_repair: The GPU runtime is missing packages.

storage.invalid_path: That folder cannot be used for downloads.
storage.path_not_absolute: Choose a full path, starting from a drive or from the root.
storage.path_too_long: That path is too long to be a folder.
storage.path_invalid: That path contains characters a folder name cannot have.
storage.not_a_directory: That path is a file, not a folder.
storage.create_failed: That folder could not be created. Check the drive is connected and not full.
storage.not_writable: That folder refused to be written to. It may be read-only, or on a share you cannot write to.
storage.inside_installation: That folder is inside the application itself, and would be erased by the next update.
storage.busy_downloading: A download is running. Stop it before moving where downloads are kept.
storage.not_remembered: The folder is in use now, but could not be saved, so the next launch will use the previous one.
storage.picker_failed: The folder picker could not be opened.

gpu.no_device: A GPU driver is installed, but no device was reported.
gpu.driver_error: The GPU driver returned an error.
gpu.driver_missing: No GPU driver was found. Generation will have to use a remote API.

window.command_failed: The window did not respond to that action.

vibrancy.apply_failed: The window blur effect could not be applied.
vibrancy.windows10_opt_in: Window blur is off by default on Windows 10, because it slows down dragging.
vibrancy.unsupported_platform: Window blur is not available on this system.

conform.bad_image: That image could not be read.
